featured.title: Reflex: Visually Grounded Reactive Humanoid Control
featured.tldr: Reflex teaches a Unitree G1 humanoid to catch thrown boxes using only onboard depth cameras, by training whole-body control first and then teaching vision to recover a compact description of the box's motion.
